name: ET1641 (DC Meter)
subtitle: Industrial - Energy Meter
description: A DC energy meter with 4-channel current measurement across 20–60V (up to 200A), 1% FSR accuracy, and RS485 for battery systems, solar installations, telecom rectifiers, and EV charging infrastructure.

use_cases.title: Telecom Power Monitoring
use_cases.desc: Tracks power consumption and electrical parameters across telecom sites, including grid supply, generators, and backup systems. It gives operators better visibility into energy usage, equipment performance, and power availability across distributed network infrastructure.

use_cases.title: Solar & Battery System Analytics
use_cases.desc: Monitors solar generation, battery charging and discharging, and overall energy storage performance in real time. This helps assess system efficiency, track battery health, and optimize the utilization of renewable energy and backup power.

use_cases.title: EV Charging & DC Infrastructure
use_cases.desc: Connects EV charging stations and DC power infrastructure to enable real-time monitoring of charging activity, power consumption, and equipment status. This supports efficient energy distribution, remote diagnostics, and reliable operation of charging networks.
